title: Kiritani Haruka — Brought Together〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Alright, let's get it started!
“Let's Put Our Heads Together! The MORE MORE Brainstorming Meeting!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!>
<Haruka's so cute!>
<I'm gonna do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As the title suggests, this meeting is about us coming up with segment ideas together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We usually come up with them together...
But since we have access to this gorgeous meeting room, we thought that it'd be fun to brainstorm with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so we hope you'll lend us some of your strength. Please feel free to post all of your ideas in the comments.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<MMJ's in for a consult!>
<What about wake-up pranks?>
<How about a karaoke stream?>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Variety stuff's fine and all, but I wanna see a show.>
<A show would be awesome!>
<I vote for a show stream.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm seeing a lot of different ideas...
But I think the comments saying that we should do a show have a majority.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we have been doing a lot of streams tied to the Lumina Grand Prix lately...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, why don't we start working on a show stream?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<A show stream?! You mean it?!>
<Yes!>
<I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, since everyone's joining us this time, why don't we come up with what we should do during it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good call. Let us know if you have any requests, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I wanna see Haruka do a cool dance!>
<Can you perform that song from your solo show?>
<A ballad by the lovely Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Please do a cover of a Miku song!>
<Sing one of your classic songs, Airi!>
<Do the dance for “Can't Fall In Love”, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, thanks for all the suggestions, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they're all pretty split...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, they are...
Doing everything wouldn't be very practical, would it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hmm...
But if there are this many different requests...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why don't we do a solo medley?
We could each sing a different chorus.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that's a great idea!
A solo medley sounds really fun.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<A solo medley?!>
<I wanna see that!>
<You're a genius, Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like they all want to see us do that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So do I! I can't wait to see you all do your solos!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you're also a part of this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So it's settled then. We'll be doing a show that includes a solo medley.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, for my solo, I'm gonna be singing one of my classics as requested.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's great!
What about you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Well...
I was also thinking about going with something cool like they requested...
bgm_area00002
The next day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. And that's why you all decided to do a show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But it's only going to be a thirty-minute mini-concert since we'll be doing it from the Lumina Forum rehearsal room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless, we plan on making it as fun as we can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's wonderful. I think we're all looking forward to seeing how it turns out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, we still don't actually know what we're going to do yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?
If that's the case, then would you like to brainstorm together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Three heads are better than one, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, I really appreciate it...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, let's start with the set list.
For this one, we're thinking about including a solo medley with all four of us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're probably going to have only enough time to sing three non-solo songs. But we're worried that some people will want more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh, what if ensemble songs were also medleys? That way, everyone would get to hear more songs, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see... That is a good idea.
It'd also allow us to do some of the other requests we received.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our set list is coming together nicely, so let's start thinking about effects next.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We may be performing in the rehearsal room, but I want to make it as interesting a stage as possible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, what if you all decorated the room yourselves? Just having a few heart-shaped balloons floating around can change things quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I like it. We could even use them as props, so it'd be nice to try a dance that includes balloons.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you two so much for helping me with this. I have a much better idea of what we're going to do now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
We're also glad that we were able to help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're really looking forward to your mini-concert. We'll be watching in secret when it happens.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, we absolutely promise to make it a good one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's starting to get off the ground thanks to Miku and MEIKO.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But there's plenty of room left for improvement, and we still need to practice for it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We need to do our best to make everyone happy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And do what we can to spread hope to as many people as we can.)
